book.name: Mak
book.title: MAK Kamambuno wakai Mak muno boglkwa

content: Nasaret yomba Yesus kamo pirkrikwa
Yesus dumo igle kindekondo ana ye ende ikine pi, ye yene yungumo kamuno ongwa. Yene disaipelma wagle ama akiye wan eingwa.

Sabat enge yongo ye mambuno bogl makai yungu yungugl yomba ka beke tongwa. Ana yomba merkinde Yesus kamo pirtre, ye sipuglo dindre ana krapeglkwa, “Yagl i taragl prapra aglokra yume? Taragl nomano wakai i ira ye to du, te aglokra yundu? Sragl ere ye kimagl kanekane orme?
Ye kamda moglkrum kana? Ye Maria wam moglkrum kana, te ye angiglma Jems, Josep, Judas te Saimon moglkrim kana? Ana ye ambaglma nono bogl akiye moglkuno?” Ana ye ka yegl dindre deno kumbro teingwa.
Yesus yomba ditongwa, “Dumo koglkoglo propet ye kangiye pangwa. Ba yene yungumugl ya bormaimo suwara ya te yombamo mina ye kangiye paikrukwa.”
Ye kimagl tau ta erambuka mere manga, suwarata orkwa i yomba kinde sungwa suwom ta ongo ye mina tembe yei ana kindeno erewakai ere tongwa.

Ana Yesus sipuglo dungwa, sraglpre, yomba pirngi dingwa paikrukwa. Yesus disaipelma 12 kongun diendungwa (Matyu 10:5-15; Luk 9:1-6) Ana Yesus endpi yungu epigl igle yeimara winambo dindre yomba kamambuno beke tongwa.
Yesus disaipel 12 prapra agle dungo wu makai singo ana ye suwo suwondi dimenda endungwa. Ye spirit kinde simenda endinaglmedi pre yombuglo giglendi tongwa.
Ana ye yegl piryo ditongwa, “Konbauna enaglkwa taragl ta ipikriyo, buglo muglmbo keme i yo, ene bret ya gagl bona ya te minge moni tau kumatno mina suna pandiglkriyo.
Katno towo endinaglkwa, ba gagl suna kawate ta ipikriyo.
Ene yungu aglokra ta dimbi ende yungugl enaglmara, yungumo igle keunde moglpai ere pi ana ende enaglkwa enge taun i kondiyo.
Ana dumo tau yomba ta ende wiyo dikrimbi, mo ene kanno pirkrimbi, ene ende enaglkwa enge katno gamba tama bagl endiyo. Ye piraglkwa mambunono kinde erikwa i ombunodi tenambuka.”
Yegl dungo ye ende menda pi yomba nomano yake tenaglkwa pre kamambuno dipene ende teingwa.
Ye spirit kinde merkinde mange menda ende, ana yomba kinde sungwa merkinde olip nuglo kungo eretendre, ana kindeno erewakai ereteingwa.
Jon Baptais nungo garikwa
King Herot ka i prapra prukwa. I Yesus kangiye pir kuno erikwa pre yomba tau yegl dingwa, “Jon Baptais goglkwa ikra andigl ukor ongwa pangwa. Yeglpre kimagl yombuglo bogl ye mina suna kongun orkwa.”
Tau yegl dingwa, “Ye Elaija.” Ana tau dingwa, “Ye propet okuna imbo meglmere yeglmere ta moglkwa.”
Ba Herot ka i pirtre yegl dungwa, “Jon Baptais na okuna nungo gare endigra. Ba ye erme andigl ukor ongwa pai dungwa!”
Herot yene okuna ka giglendi kimbirmo nem ditongo ana Jon kane sindre ipi kane yungu suna endingwa. Herot yegl orkwa i Herodias pre orkwa. Yene angigle Pilip embiye okuna ye wike yungwa.
Jon okuna ka yegl di Herot tongwa pre, “Ene angitn Pilip embiye wike inga i lo mina yegl paikrumere etnga.”
Herodias ye dem pond kumbro Jon tendre ana ye Jon sigoragledi prukwa. Ba ye kuno erekrukwa.

Herot Jon kunduglmo goglkwa, sraglpre, ye prukwa i Jon yagl du-yene, ana holi moglkwa. Yeglpre Herot eremogl Jon kanwinge orkwa. Ye eremogl Jon kamo wakai ere pruko ana ka merkinde ye nomanemo sikugl endungwa. Ba ye engenge Jon kamo piragledi prukwa.

Okuwo kaima Herodias engemo wakai plau dungwa. I Herot mam kugl yongwa engemo plau dungo ana ye kaiya mokna pond ere yomba tongwa. Gavman kongun erikwa yomba kande ya kimbirnem sutno moglkwa yagle ya te Galili dumo kande makan nem ende okuna eingwa yomba prapra wu meglkwa.

Enge igle Herodias ambuglo ende suna undre ana kagle engrukwa. I Herot ya yomba kande digaglko kaiya mokna ne meglkwa, ye kan gun yeingwa. Ana king di ambai tongwa, “Ene taragl kanekane ta inagledi piratnga, krapogl naro? Ana i na ene tenaglka.”
Ana ye ka dipandigl ambai tendre ka kaima yene we dungwa, “Taragl ta pre ene krapogl dimin na ene tenaglka, te na dumo makana simbiglkidi ikine naro dimin pra ene tenaglka.”
Ambai ende menda pi ana mam ditongwa, “Na sragl taragl naro dinagle?” Ana mam di ikine endungwa, “Jon Baptais bre.”
Ana ambai oglandi kaima ende ikine king moglmara pindre ana mam ditomere ikra di king tongwa, “Ene erme keunde Jon Baptais bre gare plet ta mina tembe yei yu na naro.”
King ka i pirtre munduwo kinde kaima orko, ye mane dinagledi prukwa, ba yomba kande gumanomugl ka di giglekui dingra wondi pirtre, ana ye pra wedi ambai tongwa.
Yeglpre ye tambre kana kimbirmo nem ta diendungwa, “Ene pi Jon bre gariwo” dungo, ana kimbirnem ende kane yungu suna pindre Jon bre garikwa.
Ana kimbirnem Jon bre gare plet ta mina bolamugl yei yu ambai tongo ana ambai ipi mam tongwa.
Jon disaipelma wagle ka i pirtre ye wu Jon nangiye indre ana ipi kombuglo dra yomba geglko pandiglmara yeingwa.
Yesus yagl 5,000 kaiya mokna tongwa
Yesus kongun eraglmedi diendungwa yomba ende ikine wu Yesus moglmara makaisi winambo dindre ana ye kongun erimere ya ka beke teimere boglo kugl Yesus teingwa.

Enge igle yomba merkinde ende wingo te ende eingo orkwa. Yesus disaipelma wagle bogl enge ta yenan kaiya mokna ninaglkwa mere manga. Yeglpre ye disaipelma wagle ditongwa, “Enene keunde wimbi na bogl nono ende dumo wau ta yenambara omun ana kurita mogl ir sinaglkwa.”
Ana ye bot ta indre, ye yene keunde ende menda pi dumo waule ta eingwa.
Ba yomba merkinde kanigwa ye ende eingo ana ye pirkan erikwa. Taun yomba prapra makandle katno pagl mukundi ende okuna kana pi ana Yesus disaipelma wagle bogl enaglmara igle eingwa.

Bot pango Yesus ende menda ungwa enge, ye yomba merkinde kaima meglkwa i kandre ana ye mitno goglkwa. Sraglpre, ye sipsip mereyegl sutno yomba moglkrikwa. Ana Yesus mambuno bogl taragl merkinde yomba beke tongwa.
Enge i ande beinambuka magl kaima orkwa, yeglpre, Yesus disaipelma wagle ye moglmara undre ana dingwa, “Igle eglkekuri yomba moglkrimara, ana ande bei kondungwa.
Yomba diendin ye pi kaiya mokna magl ta ere yaraglmara ya yomba yungu togl yenambara pindre ana yene kaiya mokna ninaglkwa pre tau topo eriyondo.”
Ba Yesus di ikine endungwa, “Ye taragl ninaglkwa enene ta i-teiyo.” Disaipelma wagle Yesus diteingwa, “Ene pitn kade no pindre ana minge mongo K200 ende bret topo ere tomun kuno erambo?”
Yesus krapogl disaipel wagle tongwa, “Ene bret sramuna yeingwa yome? Ene pi kaniyo.” Ye doko kandre ana ye diteingwa, “Bret 5 yongo te fis suwo yongwa.”
Ana Yesus disaipelma wagle ditendre, pi yomba prapra yumbusi ombuno mere endimbi kugl mina amedi molondo dungwa.
Ana ye amedi meglkwa, i ombuno tau 100 meglko, te tau 50 meglkwa.

Ana Yesus bret 5 ya te fis suwo ikra indre ana ye kanimbo heven ende, ana God diwakai yeite, ye bret buko dindre, ana disaipelma wagle tongwa ye i yumbusi yomba tenaglkwa. Ye ama fis suwo bukondi disaipelma wagle tongo ana yomba prapra bunondi tekuno erikwa.
Yomba prapra neingo ana kuno orkwa.
Ana disaipelma wagle bret ya fis ikine deruwagl orkwa gande imakaisi ana basket 12 indre gre kau singwa.
Yomba bret ya fis neingwa, ikra yagl keunde kerikwa 5,000 orkwa.
Yesus niglmong bolamugl konbauna ongwa
Oglandi Yesus disaipelma wagle diendungo bot mina suna pindre ana okuna kana ende niglmong koglo imbo Betsaida kamun eingo, yene yomba prapra di perepere ende moglkwa.
Ana yomba diende, okuwo Yesus kamange era pre ende makan meglmbe akete ongwa.
Ana mim orkwa enge, bot ende niglmong wu sunawom ungo ana Yesus ye yene makan mina moglkwa.

Ana ye kango disaipelma wagle yombuglo ere enaglkwa mere manga. Sraglpre ye enaglmara ir pond mange bot guma ake gidungwa. Iwe ande kuiya 4 klok kamun tanginagledi orkwa. Ye nigl bolamugl konbauna pindre ye kondo endinagledi orkwa.
Ba enge igle disaipelma wagle kaningo, Yesus niglmong bolamugl konbauna ungwa. Ana ye pirkwa Yesus pre gigl ta umedi pirtre ana ye kaglkane kinde ingwa.
Sraglpre disaipelma wagle prapra Yesus kandre ana ye kundugl pond geglkwa. Tambre kana Yesus disaipelma wagle dite dungwa, “Giglendi moraglmiwo. I na, kundugl goglkriyo.”
Ana Yesus bot mina mongo ende suna disaipelmo wagle meglmara ongo akiye meglko ana ir bu yongwa. Disaipelma wagle prapra sipuglodi poriya erikwa,
sraglpre, Yesus okuna bret bukondi yomba 5,000 tongwa ikra ye mambuno kiurikwa. Ye nomano torwa sungwa.
Genesaret kamun yomba kinde singwa Yesus erewakai orkwa
Ye niglmong siprak singwa enge, ende Genesaret pindre ana igle ye bot kane kogl pandiglkwa.
Ye prapra bot kondo ende menda eingo ana yomba oglandi Yesus kanpogl singwa.
Yomba mukundi ende dumo kande suna i mundu pindre ana yomba kinde sungwa gagle ere kake iyu Yesus moglme dingo pirmara igle wingwa.

Ana Yesus dumo aglokra suna omara i yungu epigl ya taun tau ya kamun kande bina, yomba kinde sungwa ye ipi maket dumo suna pandiglkwa. Ana kinde sungwa yomba ye Yesus gaglmo suna olto punduno akenaglmedi pre yomba yanadi Yesus tengwa. Ana prapra Yesus gaglmo akingwa mere kindeno argan orkwa.

footnotes.text: Yesus eremogl bret yumbusi yagl ambu tongwa enge i, ye yegl ombuno dungwa, taragl kane ta kaima erambuka yombuglo pamedi ombuno dungwa. Ba disaipel wagle pirpogl sikrikwa pre, Yesus nigl bolamugl konbo pindre te ir iwanga ka ditongo bu yongwa ipre nangino keglkwa.
